    # Initialize the array with the given formula

    # Initialize the number of operations
    operations = 0
    # Loop until all elements are equal

        # Find the minimum and maximum elements

        max_index = arr.index(max(arr))
        # Add the difference between the minimum and maximum elements to the number of operations
        operations += arr[max_index] - arr[min_index]
        # Set the value of the minimum element to the maximum element
        arr[min_index] = arr[max_index]
    # Return the number of operations
    return operations

def minOperations(n):
    # Initialize the array with the given formula
    arr = [(2 * i) + 1 for i in range(n)]
    # Initialize the number of operations

        # Find the minimum and maximum elements
        min_index = arr.index(min(arr))

        # Add the difference between the minimum and maximum elements to the number of operations
        operations += arr[max_index] - arr[min_index]
        # Set the value of the minimum element to the maximum element
        arr[min_index] = arr[max_index]
    # Return the number of operations
    return operations
